name: メッセージの既読と配信状況
prompt:
Create a faithful static Japanese message read/delivery status card, using the native preview’s 390×122 frame and exact Japanese content. Preserve the source’s two-row structure and separate the read state from the delivered state.

On a white 390×122 canvas, center one inset pale mint rounded card about 358px wide and 100px high, with 16px side margins. Add a thin divider between the two rows. First row: a small green double-check status icon, dark label 「既読」, and muted gray trailing value 「未確認」. Second row: a small gray double-check icon, dark label 「配信済み」, and muted gray trailing value 「今日 00:50」. Keep icons aligned left, labels after them, and values aligned to the right.

The source crop shows “Read” and “Delivered”; the native Japanese preview adapts the first status value to 「未確認」 and the delivered time to 「今日 00:50」. Use the preview values and colors. These are status labels and state icons, not hyperlinks; keep all text dark/gray, with no blue text. Do not use the source blue check as hyperlink styling.

No page title, phone chrome, message bubble, wallpaper, footer, extra controls, or additional text. Static image only.
reviewNotes: Reviewed against source crop and native Japanese preview. Exact localized copy; no hyperlinks in this component. Status icon colors follow the native preview.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
